stories.title: Shapovalov Dominates Jodar 6-1, 6-4 in Cincinnati R2 *(TIER 1)*

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Shapovalov doesn't do close calls against Jodar.

6-1, 6-4. The Montreal SF hero gets a harsh Cincinnati reality check from the Canadian veteran.

Second time Shapo's beaten him in 2026 — Dallas was the first.

#Tennis #CincinnatiOpen

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Jodar arrived in Cincinnati as the 19-year-old who'd just made his first Masters 1000 semifinal.

He left after 62 minutes.

Shapovalov 6-1, 6-4. A reminder that the generation gap works both ways.

#CincinnatiOpen #Tennis

stories.title: Djokovic Makes Cincinnati Return — Chasing 4th Title vs Tirante *(TIER 1)*

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Novak Djokovic hasn't played Cincinnati in 2 years.

He's a 3-time champion with a 10-match win streak here.

Sinner's out. Alcaraz is out. The path has never been clearer.

The King of Cincy is back. 🎾

#Tennis #CincinnatiOpen #Djokovic

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Djokovic vs Tirante — the opponent who beat Taylor Fritz in Montreal last week.

Nothing comes easy at this level, but this is Djokovic on his favourite hard-court stage.

3-time champion. 10-match streak. The draw is wide open.

#Tennis #CincinnatiOpen

stories.title: Hijikata Denies Monfils in Tearful Final Cincinnati Appearance *(TIER 2)*

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Rinky Hijikata rallied past Gael Monfils 2-6, 7-6, 6-3 in what may be Monfils' last Cincinnati match ever.

Monfils is retiring at season's end. He had the crowd. Hijikata had the result.

Bittersweet doesn't cover it.

#Tennis #CincinnatiOpen

stories.title: 9 Days to the US Open — Sinner, Alcaraz Absences Reshape Title Picture *(TIER 2)*

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
9 days until the US Open.

Sinner: doubtful (knee). Alcaraz: doubtful (wrist — hasn't played since April).

Zverev, Djokovic, and Shelton are circling. Swiatek just won Toronto.

Cincinnati is the last chance to make a statement.

#Tennis #USOpen #CincinnatiOpen
